On Fri, Jun 3, 2016 at 3:47 AM, Seema Sheth <seema....@gmail.com> wrote:
In RevBayes, I used the extended Newick monitor to write a .tree file with parameter values added to the branches. Though the read.beast() function in ggtree allows node parameters to be features, I am unable to properly read in a .tree file with features corresponding to branch parameters. Is there any possibility that this feature will be included in the future?

Many thanks in advance.
